responsibility: Defines the ISO mathematical interface for LONGCOMPLEX values, including constants, magnitude/phase/conjugation, transcendental functions, polar construction, scalar multiplication, and the module-specific exception-state query. It is the long-precision complex counterpart to ComplexMath and specifies the public API used by gm2 long-complex arithmetic clients.
same_name_distinction: This .def file declares the LONGCOMPLEX math API and constants for clients, while the same-stem implementation module supplies the actual builtin-backed function bodies.
